{{Top|leg}}
The '''underworld''' was a concept in [[Kashoonara]] folklore. The legendary [[Hurrungat]] was believed to have ridden out from the underworld to bind the day and night together to form dusk and then morning.<ref name="Creatures of the Galaxy">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
